_about: Villager traits: permanent, rolled when a villager arrives (one good, one bad, sometimes a third). mods are multiplied (work, hunger, speed, flee, chat, hp, atk) or added (carry, cold, start, end, fishing, learn, gossip). See scripts/traits.gd.

traits.name: Hard Worker
traits.about: Works a fifth faster, and gets hungry a little sooner.

traits.name: Lazy
traits.about: Works a fifth slower.

traits.name: Early Riser
traits.about: Starts work an hour and a half earlier.

traits.name: Night Owl
traits.about: Works two hours later into the evening, and starts an hour late.

traits.name: Strong Back
traits.about: Carries 6 more.

traits.name: Frail
traits.about: Carries 4 less, and has less health.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.about: A quarter more health.

traits.name: Sickly
traits.about: A quarter less health.

traits.name: Small Appetite
traits.about: Gets hungry a third slower.

traits.name: Glutton
traits.about: Gets hungry half again as fast.

traits.name: Thick-Skinned
traits.about: The cold doesn't slow them.

traits.name: Thin-Blooded
traits.about: Feels the cold worse: a scarf matters.

traits.name: Brave
traits.about: Stands and fights until badly hurt.

traits.name: Coward
traits.about: Runs from a fight at the first real wound.

traits.name: Sure-Footed
traits.about: Walks a fifth faster.

traits.name: Slow Walker
traits.about: Walks a fifth slower.

traits.name: Quick Learner
traits.about: Skills improve half again as fast.

traits.name: Set in Their Ways
traits.about: Skills improve a third slower.

traits.name: Born Angler
traits.about: Fishes as if three levels better.

traits.name: Chatterbox
traits.about: Stops to talk twice as often, and hears more rumors.

traits.name: Loner
traits.about: Never stops to chat, and works a little faster for it.

traits.name: Gossip
traits.about: The first to hear a rumor.

traits.name: Tight-Lipped
traits.about: The last to pass a rumor on.

traits.name: Old Soldier
traits.about: Hits half again as hard, and has more health.

traits.name: Tireless
traits.about: Works a tenth faster and walks a tenth faster.

traits.name: Jinxed
traits.about: A tenth slower at everything.

traits.name: Unique
traits.about: One of a kind. There is only one of them, and they can become more than a villager.
